## Behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link the issue and any coordinated component changes.

## Contract and evidence

Identify the owner, supported scope and relevant evidence. Explain Candidate/custom behavior and remaining limitations.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate synthetic checks, PostgreSQL fixtures and original-client observations. State skipped/unavailable checks.

## Reference and review

- [ ] Relevant feature coverage, packet overrides and generated references are updated, or this change does not alter their contract.
- [ ] Publication is synchronized, or maintainer publication is explicitly pending.
- [ ] Focused diff, readable code and no private/generated client artifacts.
- [ ] Player-facing notes describe only released, reachable gameplay changes, if any.
